The '''Assault on Galaan''' took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Not long after the end of the [[Thrawn campaign]], the New Republic maintained a vital communications base in the atmosphere of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Galaan/Legends|Galaan]]. The base was also the headquarters of the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. The secret New Republic base was discovered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces of the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]] due to the betrayal of a member of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], [[Kiara Schmong]]. Two Imperial [[Carrack-class light cruiser|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]] allied with criminal elements attacked the defenseless base. Despite the presence of a New Republic operations group in the area,<ref name="Relic" /> the Imperial forces managed to destroy the the communications center, therefore hampering New Republic communications in the sector.<ref name="Counterstrike" />
